business_summary: Carrier Global Corporation (NYSE: CARR) is the HVAC and refrigeration company spun out of United Technologies in 2020. Its ai-infrastructure exposure is the QuantumLeap product suite, which puts direct-to-chip liquid cooling and coolant distribution units for high-density data centers alongside its legacy building-cooling business, competing directly with Vertiv, Johnson Controls and Modine on the same link.

exposure_summary.narrative: CARRIER-GLOBAL has one placement, on liquid-cooling (Thermal & liquid cooling, verdict EMERGING, money_corner False). The liquid-cooling link carries a crowdedness score of 58: the category leader is widely covered while second-tier and component suppliers remain much less followed, and multiple industrial incumbents announced competing cooling lines in 2025-26, raising commoditization risk at the component layer (data/chains/ai-infrastructure.json heat, as_of 2026-08-28).
